title.en: An Act Naming the Granada-murcia Road and Extension (Circumferential Road) Which Is a National Road in Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, as the Carlos Hilado Highway

text.en: The Granada-Murcia Road and Extension (Circumferential Road), a national road in Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, is hereby named as the Carlos Hilado Highway.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 10, 1994.
